title: Cross stitch, Times Single
description: A 20 x 20 mm cross stitch region at PE-DESIGN's defaults (Size 2.5 mm) with Times Single: 64 whole cells on the page axes. PE-DESIGN covers every diagonal 2 times; OpenStitch sews each diagonal whole 1 times plus its two halves, so every step of Times adds 256 stitches in both programs (PE 410, 666, 922; OpenStitch 18 more each, its route between rows differs, #463).

references.make: On a 100 x 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm) draw a 20 x 20 mm square from (40, 40) to (60, 60) mm with Home > Shapes > Rectangle. Shapes tab > Sew: line Not Sewn (Line); region Cross Stitch, Size 2.5 mm (the default), Times Single; PE-DESIGN 11.50 shows no Direction for cross stitch. Save As 'Layout & Editing Ver 11.0 File (*.PES)'. Status bar 20,00 x 20,00 mm, 410 st.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50's file (410 st in the status bar): Times Single covers each diagonal the same number of times in both programs
